description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatControllerSessionPolicy class, specifically testing the behavior of applying main session keys in different scenarios.

classes.name: ChatControllerSessionPolicyTest
classes.description: A test class for the ChatControllerSessionPolicy, testing session key update logic.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKeyMovesCurrentSessionWhenStillOnDefault
methods.description: Tests that applying a main session key when the current session is still at default updates the current and applied session keys correctly.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKeyKeepsUserSelectedSession
methods.description: Tests that when the current session is user-selected, applying a new main session key updates only the applied session key while keeping the current session unchanged.
